in_marathi.name: Kaleshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaleshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kaleshwar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Kala’ meaning time, and ‘Ishwar’ meaning god. This name is often used to refer to the deity Shiva as the lord of time.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Time
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kaleshwar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kaleshwar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Kala’ meaning time, and ‘Ishwar’ meaning god. This name is often used to refer to the deity Shiva as the lord of time.
